text.p: Todd-AO Corp, a provider of postproduction film and television services, on Tuesday said it has named Randy Strickley to the new position of chief financial officer, effective May 19.
Strickley, 47, was managing director of enertainment/media and healthcare for BankAmerica Corp's principal unit, Bank of America, based in Los Angeles.
Over 25 years at the bank, Strickely managed corporate banking relationships and advised clients in capital raising, mergers and acquisitions and other corporate finance matters.
"Strickley brings the comprehensive knowledge of financial matters needed to coordinate (Todd-AO's) multinational expansion program," Salah Hassanein, chief executive officer, said in a statement.
